en.title: Queensland Launches New Plan to Support Students with Disabilities
en.summary: The Queensland government unveiled a new plan to support students with disabilities, including a professional learning program and a commitment to train an additional 200 teachers each year from 2026 to 2028. Meanwhile, Helena will install over 50 ADA‑compliant ramps in its 6th Ward, UK astronaut John McFall is poised to become the first disabled person to orbit, and a visual essay highlights systemic accessibility barriers while only the MAID route remains open.

highlights.title: New plan unveiled to support students with disabilities
Helena to install 50+ ADA accessible ramps in 6th Ward neighborhood - KTVH
Astronaut with disabilities set to make historic orbit entry
Visual Essay Highlights Systemic Barriers to Accessibility While MAID Path Remains Open

zh-TW.title: 昆士蘭發布殘障學生支援新計畫
zh-TW.summary: 昆士蘭政府發布新計畫，將支援殘障學生，包括專業學習計畫以及從2026年至2028年每年額外培訓200名教師。同時，海倫娜計畫在第六區安裝超過50個符合ADA標準的坡道；英國殘障宇航員約翰·麥克法爾有望成為首位軌道上生活的殘障人士；一篇視覺作品指出無障礙系統性障礙普遍存在，僅安樂死通道仍開放。

highlights.title: 新計畫發布以支援殘障學生

殘障宇航員將創造歷史性軌道進入
